## Security and operations review

- The new middleware is server-side and uses a session flash marker; no query parameter, client header, cookie value, or browser state can request suppression.
- Existing authentication, active-user checks, authorization, validation, and access checks remain unchanged and execute before the activity write. The focused suite retains a denied participant edit assertion.
- No database schema, private file, participant-data rule, secret, or historical activity row changed.
- No staging deployment or production change was performed or authorized.
- Rollback is limited to the issue-specific middleware, registration, controller guards, focused test changes, and operations-note update; the Build handoff lists the exact paths.
